# Midsummer Fire Protection

> > Comprehensive passive fire protection and fire safety services specializing in fire stopping, compartmentation, intumescent coatings, and certified fire door installation.

Midsummer Fire Protection is a UK-based fire safety specialist providing passive fire protection solutions including fire stopping installation, compartmentation surveys, intumescent coatings, fire doors, and risk assessments. The company offers both installation services and compliance inspections to help buildings meet fire safety regulations.

## Key Topics

- Passive Fire Protection
- Fire Compartmentation
- Fire Stopping Installation
- Intumescent Coatings
- Fire Doors
- Fire Barriers
- Fire Curtains
- Fire Risk Assessments
- Fire Door Inspections
- Fire Compartmentation Survey
- Fire Door Intumescent Seals
- Fire Safety Compliance
- Fire Dampers
- Passive Fire Surveys
- Fire Door Maintenance
